subtitle: Writing conditional logic into a calculated field

code:
Profitability =
IF [Profit] > 0 THEN "Profitable"
ELSEIF [Profit] = 0 THEN "Break Even"
ELSE "Loss"
END
caption: Every IF block must close with END, or it won't save.

code:
Region Code =
CASE [Region]
WHEN "East" THEN "E"
WHEN "West" THEN "W"
ELSE "?"
END
caption: One field, matched against a short list of exact values.

code:
High Value Loss =
IF [Profit] < 0 AND [Sales] > 1000
THEN "Investigate" ELSE "OK"
END
caption: AND and OR combine multiple tests inside one IF.
